title: Way too hard to assemble
text: Way too hard to assemble. Ridiculous to put together. Had to return it. Davinci should make a basic changer to go with the crib of the same wood color but it doesn’t, this is the closest you can get. Instructions don’t have words and it’s just a waste of time. My mom and I spent 2 days on it and it was just silly. Plus I couldn’t even find the matching changing top for sale in this color. Not worth it.

product_metadata.title: DaVinci Autumn 4-Drawer Dresser in Chestnut, Greenguard Gold Certified
features: GREENGUARD GOLD CERTIFIED: This product has undergone rigorous scientific testing for over 10,000 chemical emissions and VOCs. It contributes to cleaner indoor air, creating a healthier environment for your baby to sleep, play, and grow
DURABILITY: 4 spacious drawers that can hold all the adorable baby clothes, blanket, and more. NEW AND IMPROVED with thicker drawer bottoms to make it sturdier and long-lasting

VERSATILE DESIGN: Changing station now. Big kid dresser later! This dresser is designed so that you can add a DaVinci changing tray (#M0219) to use as a convenient changing station during the baby years
SMOOTH GLIDE: Pre-installed ball-bearing drawer glides that make opening the drawers easy even when your hands are full with baby
QUALITY MATERIAL: Made of solid sustainable New Zealand pinewood and TSCA compliant engineered wood
description: The new and improved Autumn 4-Drawer Dresser features two smaller dressers on top with two larger ones on the bottom, offering a convenient range of storage options to keep all of baby necessities neatly organized.
